items.extra: avoir besoin de + 名词 / 不定式
items.fr: Ninon [a besoin d']un parapluie : il pleut.
items.sen: Ninon needs an umbrella: it's raining.
items.szh: 妮侬需要一把伞：下雨了。
items.scene: Ninon stands under heavy rain with no umbrella, holding a newspaper over her head and looking longingly at an umbrella in a shop window. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: besoin = 需要；后面的 de 不能丢。

items.extra: avoir envie de + 名词 / 不定式
items.fr: Pia [a envie d']une glace au chocolat.
items.sen: Pia feels like a chocolate ice cream.
items.szh: 皮娅很想吃一个巧克力冰淇淋。
items.scene: Pia gazes dreamily at an ice-cream stand, a thought bubble above her head showing a chocolate ice-cream cone. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: envie 是“想要的念头”；比 vouloir 更口语、更随性。

items.extra: avoir peur de + 名词 / 不定式
items.fr: Lison [a peur des] araignées.
items.sen: Lison is afraid of spiders.
items.szh: 莉松害怕蜘蛛。
items.scene: Lison jumps onto a chair, frightened, pointing at a tiny spider on the floor. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: 法语说“有害怕”（avoir peur），不说“是害怕”。

items.extra: avoir raison de + 不定式；反义：avoir tort
items.fr: Tu [as raison] : il faut tourner à gauche.
items.sen: You're right: we have to turn left.
items.szh: 你说得对：应该向左转。
items.scene: Two sisters look at a map at a crossroads; Ninon points left and Pia nods, checking the map which clearly shows the left road leading to the destination flag. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: raison = 道理；“有道理”就是说得对。

items.extra: avoir tort de + 不定式；反义：avoir raison
items.fr: J'[ai tort] : le musée est fermé le mardi.
items.sen: I'm wrong: the museum is closed on Tuesdays.
items.szh: 我错了：博物馆星期二不开门。
items.scene: Lison stands embarrassed in front of a closed museum door with a closed shutter, scratching her head while Pia crosses her arms. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: tort = 过错；avoir tort 和 avoir raison 成对记。

items.extra: 主语是活动或事件；avoir lieu + 时间 / 地点
items.fr: Le concert [a lieu] sur la place du village.
items.sen: The concert takes place in the village square.
items.szh: 音乐会在村子的广场上举行。
items.scene: A small outdoor concert on a village square: a stage with musicians, an audience, bunting; the square itself is clearly the setting. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: lieu = 地点；“有地点”就是“在某处举行”。

items.en: to have a pain in, to hurt
items.extra: avoir mal à + 身体部位（au / à la / aux）
items.fr: Pia [a mal à] la tête depuis ce matin.
items.sen: Pia has had a headache since this morning.
items.szh: 皮娅从今天早上起就头疼。
items.scene: Pia sits at a desk holding her forehead with one hand, small pain marks around her head, a glass of water and a morning sun in the window. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: mal = 疼痛；à 后面接疼的部位。

items.extra: avoir l'air + 形容词 / avoir l'air de + 不定式
items.fr: Ce gâteau [a l'air] délicieux.
items.sen: This cake looks delicious.
items.szh: 这个蛋糕看起来很好吃。
items.scene: A beautifully decorated cake in a bakery window; Ninon looks at it with sparkling eyes, hands on the glass. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: air = 样子；“有……的样子”。

items.en: to be used to, to usually do
items.extra: avoir l'habitude de + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Ninon [a l'habitude de] lire avant de dormir.
items.sen: Ninon is used to reading before going to sleep.
items.szh: 妮侬习惯睡前看书。
items.scene: Ninon in bed at night with a bedside lamp, reading a book; a small pile of already-read books on the night table suggests a nightly routine. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain, clean readable focal relationships
items.hook: habitude = 习惯；和已学的 s'habituer à 同根。

items.en: to be in the middle of doing
items.extra: être en train de + 不定式（表示动作正在进行）
items.fr: Lison [est en train de] préparer le dîner.
items.sen: Lison is in the middle of making dinner.
items.szh: 莉松正在做晚饭。
items.scene: Lison at the stove mid-action, stirring a steaming pot with one hand and holding a spoon to taste with the other; vegetables half-chopped on the board. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: bold clean shapes, crisp outlines, minimal flat shading, bright friendly palette
items.hook: 法语没有进行时，用 être en train de 强调“正在”。

items.extra: être d'accord avec qn / pour + 不定式
items.fr: Je [suis d'accord] avec toi : partons maintenant.
items.sen: I agree with you: let's leave now.
items.szh: 我同意你的看法：我们现在出发吧。
items.scene: Two sisters shake hands and smile, both giving a thumbs-up, with packed bags at their feet ready to leave. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: bold clean shapes, crisp outlines, minimal flat shading, bright friendly palette
items.hook: accord = 一致；d'accord 单独说就是“好的”。

items.extra: 反义：être en avance（提前）、être à l'heure（准时）
items.fr: Pia [est en retard] : le train part déjà.
items.sen: Pia is late: the train is already leaving.
items.szh: 皮娅迟到了：火车已经开了。
items.scene: Pia runs along a station platform with her bag flying, a large clock above, as the train doors close and the train starts to move. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: bold clean shapes, crisp outlines, minimal flat shading, bright friendly palette
items.hook: retard = 延迟；已学的 retard 是名词，这里是整个说法。

items.en: to be in good shape, to feel great
items.extra: être en pleine forme = 状态极佳
items.fr: Après les vacances, Ninon [est en forme].
items.sen: After the holidays, Ninon is in great shape.
items.szh: 假期过后，妮侬精神很好。
items.scene: Ninon back from holiday, tanned and energetic, jogging happily with a suitcase tag still on her bag in the background. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: bold clean shapes, crisp outlines, minimal flat shading, bright friendly palette
items.hook: forme = 状态、体形；en forme 就是“状态在线”。

items.en: to pay attention to, to be careful with
items.extra: faire attention à + 名词；Fais attention ! = 小心！
items.fr: [Fais attention à] la marche !
items.sen: Mind the step!
items.szh: 小心台阶！
items.scene: Lison holds out an arm to stop Pia just before a step she hasn't noticed; the step is clearly highlighted at the centre. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: attention = 注意力；“做注意”就是留神。

items.en: to queue, to stand in line
items.extra: faire la queue devant / pour + 名词
items.fr: Nous [faisons la queue] devant la boulangerie.
items.sen: We are queuing in front of the bakery.
items.szh: 我们在面包店门口排队。
items.scene: A neat line of people, with the three sisters among them, waiting outside a bakery whose window shows bread; the queue is the main subject. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: queue = 尾巴；排成一条“尾巴”。

items.extra: faire des courses = 买点东西
items.fr: Le samedi, Lison [fait les courses] au marché.
items.sen: On Saturdays, Lison does the shopping at the market.
items.szh: 每周六，莉松去市场买菜。
items.scene: Lison at an open-air market with a basket full of vegetables and a baguette, paying a stallholder. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: courses 在这里是“采购”，不是“赛跑”。

items.extra: 近义：cuisiner
items.fr: Ninon aime [faire la cuisine] pour ses amies.
items.sen: Ninon likes cooking for her friends.
items.szh: 妮侬喜欢给朋友们做饭。
items.scene: Ninon in an apron happily cooking several dishes, while her two friends wait at a set table in the background. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: cuisine 既是“厨房”也是“烹饪”。

items.en: to meet, to get to know (for the first time)
items.extra: faire la connaissance de qn；Enchanté(e) de faire votre connaissance.
items.fr: Pia [fait la connaissance de] sa nouvelle voisine.
items.sen: Pia meets her new neighbour.
items.szh: 皮娅认识了她的新邻居。
items.scene: Pia shakes hands with a new neighbour on a landing between two apartment doors, moving boxes beside the neighbour's door. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: connaissance = 认识；已学的 connaissance 是名词，这里指“初次结识”。

items.extra: faire de mon / ton / son mieux
items.fr: Je [fais de mon mieux] pour apprendre le français.
items.sen: I'm doing my best to learn French.
items.szh: 我在尽力学法语。
items.scene: Lison studies hard at a desk late in the evening with books, notes and a cup of tea, determined expression, a small progress chart rising on the wall. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: mieux = 更好；“做到自己最好的程度”。

items.extra: faire semblant de + 不定式
items.fr: Le chat [fait semblant de] dormir.
items.sen: The cat is pretending to sleep.
items.szh: 猫在假装睡觉。
items.scene: A cat lies curled up with one eye slyly half-open, watching a fish on the table, while Pia tiptoes past believing it is asleep. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book illustration: opaque matte brushwork, saturated color blocks, soft handmade edges
items.hook: semblant = 外表；“做个样子”。

items.extra: prendre rendez-vous avec qn / chez le médecin
items.fr: Je [prends rendez-vous] chez le dentiste.
items.sen: I'm making an appointment with the dentist.
items.szh: 我在预约看牙医。
items.scene: Ninon on the phone, holding a calendar with one day circled, a tooth icon on a dentist's door sign in a thought bubble. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: rendez-vous = 约会、预约；动词用 prendre（取）。

items.extra: prendre soin de qn / qch
items.fr: Lison [prend soin de] ses plantes.
items.sen: Lison takes care of her plants.
items.szh: 莉松细心照料她的植物。
items.scene: Lison gently waters and wipes the leaves of several healthy potted plants on a balcony. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: soin = 照料；“取照料”就是照顾。

items.extra: 法语说 prendre（取）一个决定，不说 faire
items.fr: Pia doit [prendre une décision] avant ce soir.
items.sen: Pia has to make a decision before tonight.
items.szh: 皮娅必须在今晚之前做出决定。
items.scene: Pia stands at a fork between two doors of different colours, a clock on the wall showing early evening, hand on chin. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: 已学 décider（动词）；名词搭配用 prendre。

items.extra: rendre visite à qn；参观地方用 visiter
items.fr: Dimanche, nous [rendons visite à] notre grand-mère.
items.sen: On Sunday, we are visiting our grandmother.
items.szh: 星期天，我们去看望奶奶。
items.scene: The three sisters arrive at their grandmother's door with flowers and a cake; the grandmother opens the door with open arms. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: 看人用 rendre visite à，看地方用 visiter。

items.extra: tomber en panne d'essence = 没油了
items.fr: La voiture [tombe en panne] sur la route.
items.sen: The car breaks down on the road.
items.szh: 汽车在路上抛锚了。
items.scene: A car stopped at the roadside with the bonnet open and smoke coming out; Ninon looks at the engine, warning triangle behind the car. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: panne = 故障；“掉进故障里”。

items.extra: tomber amoureux / amoureuse de qn
items.fr: Le chat [tombe amoureux] de la petite chatte blanche.
items.sen: The cat falls in love with the little white cat.
items.szh: 那只猫爱上了小白猫。
items.scene: A tabby cat with heart-shaped eyes stares at an elegant white cat on a wall; small hearts float above him. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: 和英语 fall in love 一样用“掉”（tomber）。

items.extra: changer d'avis sur qch
items.fr: Pia [change d'avis] : elle prend le gâteau.
items.sen: Pia changes her mind: she takes the cake.
items.szh: 皮娅改了主意：她要蛋糕。
items.scene: Pia at a café counter pushes away a salad she had first pointed at and now points decisively at a slice of cake. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: avis = 意见；注意 d' 后面不加冠词。

items.en: to give a hand, to help out
items.extra: donner un coup de main à qn
items.fr: Lison [donne un coup de main] à sa voisine.
items.sen: Lison gives her neighbour a hand.
items.szh: 莉松帮了邻居一把。
items.scene: Lison helps an elderly neighbour carry heavy shopping bags up the stairs, taking most of the bags. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: coup de main 字面是“手的一下”，就是搭把手。

items.extra: jeter un coup d'œil à / sur qch
items.fr: Ninon [jette un coup d'œil] à sa montre.
items.sen: Ninon glances at her watch.
items.szh: 妮侬看了一眼手表。
items.scene: Ninon walking briskly, raising her wrist and glancing quickly at her watch, motion lines suggesting a brief look. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: coup d'œil = “眼睛的一下”；jeter 是“扔”，扔出一眼。

items.extra: poser une question à qn；法语不说 demander une question
items.fr: L'élève [pose une question] à la professeure.
items.sen: The pupil asks the teacher a question.
items.szh: 学生向老师提了一个问题。
items.scene: In a classroom a pupil raises a hand with a question-mark-shaped speech bubble (symbol only), the teacher turns towards them attentively. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: 问问题用 poser（放），是固定搭配。

items.extra: 注意：不是“通过考试”；通过是 réussir un examen
items.fr: Demain, Pia [passe un examen] de français.
items.sen: Tomorrow, Pia is sitting a French exam.
items.szh: 明天皮娅要参加法语考试。
items.scene: Pia seated at an exam desk in a row of desks, writing on a paper, a clock on the wall; nothing indicates the result yet. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: 假朋友：passer un examen 只是“去考”，考过了才是 réussir。

items.extra: se mettre à + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Soudain, il [se met à] pleuvoir.
items.sen: Suddenly, it starts to rain.
items.szh: 突然下起雨来。
items.scene: A picnic scene where the first big raindrops begin to fall from a suddenly dark cloud; the sisters look up in surprise and start to gather things. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: mettre = 放；se mettre à 是“把自己放到某事上”，即开始。

items.extra: venir de + 不定式 = 最近过去时
items.fr: Le train [vient de] partir.
items.sen: The train has just left.
items.szh: 火车刚刚开走。
items.scene: An empty platform with the back of a train just pulling away in the distance, a puff of wind and Lison arriving a second too late. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored-pencil illustration: delicate layered pencil strokes, warm paper texture, clear expressive characters
items.hook: venir de + 动词原形 = “刚刚”；和 aller + 原形（即将）相对。

items.fr: J'arrive [tout de suite] !
items.sen: I'm coming right away!
items.szh: 我马上就来！
items.scene: Ninon drops what she is doing and rushes towards the door where someone is waiting, speed lines behind her. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: suite = 接续；“全接着”就是立刻。

items.extra: 近义：soudain
items.fr: [Tout à coup], la lumière s'éteint.
items.sen: Suddenly, the light goes out.
items.szh: 突然，灯灭了。
items.scene: A living room in two halves: on the left the lamp is on and Pia is reading; on the right everything is suddenly dark and only her surprised eyes are visible. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: coup = 一下；“全在一下之间”。

items.en: in a little while; a little while ago
items.extra: 可指不久前，也可指不久后，看时态；À tout à l'heure ! = 一会儿见
items.fr: Je t'appelle [tout à l'heure], après le déjeuner.
items.sen: I'll call you in a little while, after lunch.
items.szh: 我过一会儿、吃完午饭给你打电话。
items.scene: Lison at lunch pointing to her phone and then to a clock showing a slightly later time, signalling 'later'. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: l'heure = 钟点；指“这个钟点前后”。

items.fr: [De temps en temps], nous allons au cinéma.
items.sen: From time to time, we go to the cinema.
items.szh: 我们偶尔去看电影。
items.scene: A monthly calendar with only two or three days marked by a small film-reel icon, and the sisters entering a cinema. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: temps 出现两次：“从一个时间到另一个时间”。

items.extra: comme d'habitude = 像往常一样
items.fr: [D'habitude], Ninon prend le bus de huit heures.
items.sen: Usually, Ninon takes the eight o'clock bus.
items.szh: 平时，妮侬坐八点的公共汽车。
items.scene: Ninon waiting at a bus stop with a clock showing 8, the same scene repeated faintly three times in a row to suggest a routine. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: 和 avoir l'habitude de 同根。

items.fr: [En général], les magasins ferment à dix-neuf heures.
items.sen: In general, shops close at seven p.m.
items.szh: 一般来说，商店晚上七点关门。
items.scene: A shopping street at dusk where most shops are pulling down their shutters at the same time, a street clock showing 7. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Layered cut-paper collage: crisp cut silhouettes, tactile paper fibers, gentle layered shadows
items.hook: 和英语 in general 对应。

items.extra: 单独使用表示“完全正确”
items.fr: Tu as [tout à fait] raison.
items.sen: You are absolutely right.
items.szh: 你说得完全对。
items.scene: Pia nods emphatically with both thumbs up towards Lison who has just explained something, a full, completely filled circle symbol between them. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph illustration: visible grain, slightly offset ink layers, bold graphic shapes; retain signature hair, eye and dress colors
items.hook: fait = 事实；“完全是这样”。

items.fr: Il y a [à peu près] vingt personnes dans la salle.
items.sen: There are about twenty people in the room.
items.szh: 房间里大约有二十个人。
items.scene: A room with a crowd of roughly twenty people, Ninon counting them loosely with a finger and making an 'approximately' hand gesture. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph illustration: visible grain, slightly offset ink layers, bold graphic shapes; retain signature hair, eye and dress colors
items.hook: peu = 少，près = 近；“差一点点就到”。

items.fr: J'ai rencontré Lison [par hasard] au marché.
items.sen: I met Lison by chance at the market.
items.szh: 我在市场上碰巧遇到了莉松。
items.scene: Two sisters bump into each other at a market stall, both surprised and delighted, shopping baskets in hand. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph illustration: visible grain, slightly offset ink layers, bold graphic shapes; retain signature hair, eye and dress colors
items.hook: hasard = 偶然、运气。

items.fr: Il faut dormir [au moins] sept heures.
items.sen: You need to sleep at least seven hours.
items.szh: 至少要睡七个小时。
items.scene: Pia asleep in bed, a clock arc above showing a night span of seven hours shaded, with an arrow continuing beyond. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph illustration: visible grain, slightly offset ink layers, bold graphic shapes; retain signature hair, eye and dress colors
items.hook: moins = 更少；“最少也要”。

items.en: on behalf of, in the name of
items.fr: J'ai réservé une table [au nom de] Ninon.
items.sen: I booked a table in Ninon's name.
items.szh: 我用妮侬的名字订了一张桌子。
items.scene: At a restaurant entrance, a waiter checks a reservation book while Lison points towards Ninon standing beside her. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Isometric stylized 3D diorama: clear geometry, friendly adult characters, soft global illumination
items.hook: nom = 名字；“用……的名字”。

items.extra: À propos, … = 对了，……
items.fr: Elle pose une question [à propos du] voyage.
items.sen: She asks a question about the trip.
items.szh: 她问了一个关于旅行的问题。
items.scene: Pia raises her hand in a meeting while pointing at a travel poster with a suitcase and plane icons on the wall. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Isometric stylized 3D diorama: clear geometry, friendly adult characters, soft global illumination
items.hook: propos = 话题。

items.fr: Le musée est ouvert [à partir de] dix heures.
items.sen: The museum is open from ten o'clock.
items.szh: 博物馆从十点起开放。
items.scene: A museum entrance with a clock showing 10 and the doors just opening as the first visitors, including Ninon, walk in. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Isometric stylized 3D diorama: clear geometry, friendly adult characters, soft global illumination
items.hook: partir = 出发；“从……出发算起”。

items.extra: en cas de + 名词（不加冠词）
items.fr: [En cas de] pluie, le pique-nique est annulé.
items.sen: In case of rain, the picnic is cancelled.
items.szh: 如果下雨，野餐就取消。
items.scene: Two panels: a sunny picnic with the sisters; and the same lawn empty under rain, with the picnic basket being carried away. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Isometric stylized 3D diorama: clear geometry, friendly adult characters, soft global illumination
items.hook: cas = 情况；“在……的情况下”。

items.fr: Ce sac est léger [par rapport à] l'autre.
items.sen: This bag is light compared with the other one.
items.szh: 和另一个包相比，这个包很轻。
items.scene: Lison easily lifts a small bag with one finger while Pia struggles with a huge heavy bag next to her. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Isometric stylized 3D diorama: clear geometry, friendly adult characters, soft global illumination
items.hook: rapport = 关系；“按和……的关系来看”。

items.en: that is to say, in other words
items.extra: 用来解释或说得更确切
items.fr: Je pars dans deux jours, [c'est-à-dire] jeudi.
items.sen: I'm leaving in two days, that is, on Thursday.
items.szh: 我两天后出发，也就是星期四。
items.scene: Ninon points at a weekly calendar strip: today is marked, an arrow jumps two cells forward to a highlighted day with a suitcase icon. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Ink and light color wash: flowing ink contours with airy pigment washes, retaining each character's full signature palette
items.hook: 字面“这就是说”；和已学的 autrement dit 意思接近。

items.extra: à ton / son / notre avis
items.fr: [À mon avis], ce film est trop long.
items.sen: In my opinion, this film is too long.
items.szh: 依我看，这部电影太长了。
items.scene: Pia in a cinema seat yawning and pointing to herself while looking at her watch, the screen still showing the film. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Ink and light color wash: flowing ink contours with airy pigment washes, retaining each character's full signature palette
items.hook: avis = 意见；和 changer d'avis 同一个词。

items.extra: 用来确认或解释前一句话
items.fr: Il fait froid ; [en effet], il neige.
items.sen: It's cold; indeed, it's snowing.
items.szh: 天很冷；的确，下雪了。
items.scene: Lison shivering in a scarf looks out of a window where snow is clearly falling, confirming what she feels. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Ink and light color wash: flowing ink contours with airy pigment washes, retaining each character's full signature palette
items.hook: effet = 效果、事实；“在事实上”。

items.extra: ça dépend de + 名词
items.fr: — Tu viens demain ? — [Ça dépend] du temps.
items.sen: — Are you coming tomorrow? — It depends on the weather.
items.szh: ——你明天来吗？——看天气。
items.scene: Ninon makes a 'maybe' gesture with her hand tilting, between two thought bubbles: one with a sun, one with rain clouds. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: cute large heads and small rounded bodies, adult character identities and hairstyles, clean lively silhouettes
items.hook: dépendre de = 取决于；口语里只说 Ça dépend。

items.extra: 口语常说 C'est pas grave
items.fr: Tu as cassé le verre ? [Ce n'est pas grave].
items.sen: You broke the glass? It doesn't matter.
items.szh: 你把杯子打碎了？没关系。
items.scene: Pia looks sorry beside a broken glass on the floor while Ninon smiles kindly and pats her shoulder, already holding a small broom. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: cute large heads and small rounded bodies, adult character identities and hairstyles, clean lively silhouettes
items.hook: grave = 严重的；“不严重”就是没关系。

items.extra: Bonne chance pour + 名词
items.fr: [Bonne chance] pour ton examen !
items.sen: Good luck for your exam!
items.szh: 祝你考试顺利！
items.scene: Ninon and Lison wave and cross their fingers as Pia walks into an exam hall carrying pens. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: cute large heads and small rounded bodies, adult character identities and hairstyles, clean lively silhouettes
items.hook: chance = 运气（不是“机会”）。

items.extra: 用来愉快地接受邀请或请求
items.fr: — Tu veux un café ? — [Avec plaisir] !
items.sen: — Would you like a coffee? — With pleasure!
items.szh: ——你要喝杯咖啡吗？——很乐意！
items.scene: Lison offers a cup of coffee and Ninon accepts it with a big smile and both hands out. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: cute large heads and small rounded bodies, adult character identities and hairstyles, clean lively silhouettes
items.hook: plaisir = 愉快；“带着愉快”。
